blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Three runs of steps/06 on the medium season, same data, give three plans. What cause does the lesson name?

options.text: The generator draws a different season on each run
options.says: The data is the same each run; the seeded generator gives the same season.

options.text: A bug in the model lets some runs break a rule
options.says: Each plan keeps every rule; the code has no bug to fix.

options.text: The medium season was proven optimal in each run
options.says: Every run ended FEASIBLE; none is proven optimal.

options.text: A clock stops the search, and the workers race
options.says: Right: a wall-clock limit and racing workers are the two causes.

origin.section: Four Racing Workers and a Wall Clock Give a Different Plan Each Run

questions.stem: Why does the plan's record leave out the run's wall time?

options.text: The wall time is already part of the input's fingerprint
options.says: The fingerprint hashes the season and the overrides only.

options.text: It differs every run, so two records could never be equal
options.says: Right: values that differ every run by nature would keep any two records from comparing equal.

options.text: Golden files can hold whole numbers only, not seconds
options.says: The golden record holds 10.0 for the deterministic limit.

options.text: The settings already fix the wall time of every run
options.says: The same work takes a different number of seconds on a busy machine.

questions.stem: The repeatable medium plan carries more risk than the racing runs found. What does the lesson conclude?

options.text: Determinism made the plan worse, so the race should stay
options.says: The design note argues the opposite: a plan nobody can reproduce is not an answer.

options.text: The repeatable plan is optimal, so the racing plans are wrong
options.says: The repeatable plan is FEASIBLE, not proven optimal, and the racing plans keep every rule.

options.text: More work buys a better plan, and the limit goes in the record
options.says: Right: give the search more work, and write the new limit into the record.

options.text: The racing plans broke rules the repeatable plan keeps
options.says: None of the racing plans is wrong: each keeps every rule.
